turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, I'm the attorney representing your grandson. He was arrested after a traffic stop.

turns.speaker: subscriber
turns.text: Oh my goodness, is he hurt?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He's okay, but the judge set bond at two thousand dollars. It has to be cash, and a courier will come to your door to collect it this evening.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He asked me to keep this between us so his parents don't find out.
